AAPL’s profit would be $10.76B giving it 21.85 P/E if the $2.19 EPS is correct. After having $2.73 EPS previously, Apple Inc.’s analysts see -19.78% EPS growth. The company has market cap of $3.02 billion. It operates interstate natural gas and NGLs pipeline systems, and integrated storage facilities. It has a 11.2 P/E ratio. The companyÂ’s pipeline systems contain approximately 13,930 interconnected natural gas pipelines, directly serving clients in 13 states and indirectly serving clients throughout the northeastern and southeastern United States through various interconnections with unaffiliated pipelines.
